contract: A BM25-style ranking function module (RankEvolve freeform seed) scored by the paper's evaluator on the BRIGHT split: combined_score from nDCG@10 and recall@100
notes: The pinned RankEvolve loader fetches the BRIGHT documents and examples from the Hub on first use (hundreds of megabytes per split).
protocol_description: The paper's pinned evaluator, executed through the repository's upstream adapter (original). The pinned source is fetched by `python3 run.py setup rankevolve-leetcode`; data preparation is described in the notes.
name: leetcode
description: leetcode task evaluated in RankEvolve: Automating the Discovery of Retrieval Algorithms via LLM-Driven Evolution.
limitations: Execution interface inspected in pinned source. Full paper experiments have not been reproduced here.

Using a task to evaluate an agent, framework, or general-purpose model, or citing only a benchmark, dataset, or tool, does not establish scientific importance.
